According to a report by The Block, Router Protocol’s official announcement says it will close the project and burn/destroy all 303 million ROUTE tokens. The reason is straightforward: the team tried three ways to commercialize—business efforts, technology licensing, and finding buyers to take over—but none worked. They couldn’t build a sustainable business model. This is a project Coinbase invested in, and in the end it still exited in a dignified way—at least it didn’t run away. Choosing to destroy the tokens is one of the cleanest exits possible.

In one sentence: not hacked, not a rug pull—just serious business that couldn’t be made to work, so they chose to close the door themselves.

Market impact
- Short term: a direct hit to ROUTE holders, but basically no impact on the overall market. BTC is currently $79,724, down only 0.11% in 24h, while ETH is $2,502, almost unchanged. Shutting down small projects at the current scale is not even noise in the market.

The cross-chain sector itself has been squeezed hard by top players like LayerZero and Wormhole. Protocols in the middleware category without a moat are simply left with this kind of outcome.

I categorize this news as a long-term positive. A dying project exits properly, destroying tokens instead of dragging things on while draining value—that’s just normal industry clearing. - Medium term: It brings the question of whether AI will affect crypto pricing to the forefront. If the AI narrative continues to gain traction, more long/short duels like this will emerge, and market attention will keep circling back to this line.

The Berlin state government is taking a hard line against the ransomware group. It did not pay the 30 BTC, and 5.7TB of residents’ data has been posted on the dark web.

According to BeInCrypto, the Rhysida ransomware organization attacked the Berlin state government system on August 14, demanding 30 BTC—valued at about €2 million based on the Berlin chancellery’s estimates. The state government made its position clear: no payment and no bowing to extortion. After the deadline passed, the hackers went ahead and publicly released the stolen data—5.7TB—on the dark web. The official sources also warned residents that their personal information may be included.

Put simply, it’s a public standoff: the government bets its credibility on a “never compromise” stance, while the hackers force payment through a data leak. Over the past two years, more and more European government agencies have seen incidents like this—while fewer are actually paying. That’s because the FBI and EU regulators have been urging companies and institutions not to pay.

One-line translation: The government would rather take the hit from a data leak than give the hackers a paycheck. That’s bad news for the ransomware industry chain itself.

In Crypto funding, $10 million is small—but what matters is the direction, not the amount. - Medium term: If the repatriation wave expands, the credit premium of the dollar could be eroded, and global allocation logic may gradually shift toward hard assets—gold and BTC are both on the list. This is the real slow-moving variable.

According to CryptoBriefing, Microsoft published a new paper revealing an efficient knowledge distillation method that can “compress” the capabilities of large models into a smaller model like GPT-5.4-mini at a much lower cost. Put simply: in the past, only big tech companies could afford AI capabilities, but now small and medium teams can obtain them cheaply. This is a positive development at the AI infrastructure layer—but today the crypto market’s reaction has been muted. BTC $79,778.63 (24h -0.11%), ETH $2,504.82 (24h -0.03%), basically going nowhere.

In-depth analysis

Why is this news important?

The core impact of improved distillation efficiency is: lower AI inference costs → faster AI application adoption → increased uncertainty in total compute demand. Why? Because with less compute consumed per task, the market will start debating whether “efficiency gains expand demand or compress it”—and that is the central contradiction that has been tugging at the AI compute narrative over the past year.

For the crypto market, the transmission path of this news is indirect: lower barriers for developing AI agents and AI+Crypto projects (like Worldcoin). 行情越不动，人越想动。
涨的时候怕踏空。
跌的时候想抄底。

因为你总觉得：

换个币？
加点仓？
开个合约？
找一个还没涨的？

真正考验一个交易者的，恰恰不是暴涨暴跌。

因为暴涨的时候，你知道市场在奖励多头。
暴跌的时候，你知道风险正在释放。
唯独横盘的时候，

看你会不会因为无聊而交易。
会不会因为别人某个币突然拉了10%，就临时改变计划。

我们无法接受市场暂时没有机会。

让市场休息一下。
也让自己安静一下。
真正的行情来了，自然会在K线上留下痕迹。
向上突破，我们有向上的应对。
向下突破，我们有向下的规则。
至于现在？
没有信号的时候，
不交易，本身也是一种交易。
币圈每天24小时开着。
但不代表你24小时都必须参与。
有时候市场真正想考你的，
不是你会不会抓住机会。
而是——
机会还没来的时候，你能不能坐得住。
昨晚到今天这段横盘，
你现在是什么状态？

① 已经忍不住换仓了

What is ARB on Solana really aiming for? This move is more worth watching than the price swings in the middle of a cross-chain battle

According to Crypto Briefing, Sunrise used Wormhole NTT to bring Arbitrum’s ARB to Solana. This in itself isn’t a big deal, but the logic behind it is worth unpacking.

What exactly happened

NTT (Native Token Transferral) is the cross-chain standard created by Wormhole. It ensures that after tokens are bridged, they don’t turn into “wrapped assets,” but instead retain their native properties. Put simply: in the past, sending ARB to Solana meant it had to become something like WARB—an inferior second-class citizen. Now, it’s like holding the same person’s two passports.

One sentence translation: cross-chain assets have evolved from “contract manufacturing with a label” to “direct supply from the original source,” without fragmenting liquidity across multiple versions.

Why it’s worth paying attention

The broader backdrop right now is BTC at $79,691.78 (24h -0.30%) and ETH at $2,498.73 (24h -0.24%), with market sentiment staying cautious and lacking fresh hotspots. In such periods, infrastructure builds often become the window to watch for the next cycle—before the last DeFi surge, laying cross-chain bridges also came before capital truly moved in.

Arbitrum is an Ethereum-based L2, while Solana is Ethereum’s “rival.” ARB proactively goes to Solana, which suggests the project team has already acknowledged the multi-chain reality: users’ money goes where liquidity must follow, and ideology-driven camp narratives are giving way to pragmatism.

title: Les rebondissements du marché crypto : Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana et BNB sur les deux derniers mois
subTitle:
Les mois de juillet et août 2026 ont offert un véritable spectacle sur les marchés des cryptomonnaies. Après une période de relative consolidation, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana et BNB ont enchaîné les variations marquées, portés par des flux institutionnels, des espoirs réglementaires et une rotation progressive des capitaux vers les altcoins. Voici un retour sur les principaux mouvements et la tendance dominante.

Un mois de juillet en demi-teinte

En juillet, le marché restait prudent. Bitcoin évoluait autour des 63 000 à 65 000 dollars en fin de mois, affichant une progression d’environ 7 %. Ethereum se montrait plus dynamique, avec une hausse proche de 20 %, portant le ratio ETH/BTC à des niveaux plus favorables. Solana stagnait dans une fourchette de 74 à 77 dollars, toujours éloigné de ses sommets antérieurs, tandis que BNB se maintenait autour de 590 à 610 dollars.

Le contexte macroéconomique, notamment les décisions de la Réserve fédérale américaine, limitait les élans haussiers. Les investisseurs restaient attentifs aux flux des ETF spot et aux perspectives de régulation aux États-Unis.

Août : le grand rebond

Août a marqué un tournant clair. Bitcoin a grimpé d’environ 25 %, franchissant à plusieurs reprises la barre des 80 000 dollars et atteignant des pics proches de 81 000 à 82 000 dollars. Ethereum a encore mieux performé, avec une progression d’environ 32 %, tandis que Solana progressait de près de 30 % et repassait durablement au-dessus des 100 dollars. BNB suivait le mouvement avec une hausse d’environ 18 à 23 %, s’installant autour de 700 à 740 dollars.

Plusieurs éléments ont soutenu cette reprise. Les entrées de capitaux dans les ETF Bitcoin et Ethereum ont été particulièrement solides, dépassant parfois le milliard de dollars sur certaines semaines. Les espoirs d’une clarification réglementaire aux États-Unis, combinés à une demande institutionnelle renouvelée et à des signaux techniques positifs (reprise au-dessus de moyennes mobiles importantes), ont favorisé un regain d’appétit pour le risque. Solana a également bénéficié de l’attention portée à ses mises à jour techniques, notamment le protocole Alpenglow.

Début septembre : consolidation et prise de bénéfices

Au début du mois de septembre, le marché est entré dans une phase de consolidation. Bitcoin oscille autour des 79 000 à 80 000 dollars et peine à s’installer durablement au-dessus des 82 000 dollars, un niveau qui a déjà repoussé les hausses à deux reprises cette année. Ethereum se situe près de 2 490 dollars, Solana autour de 104 dollars et BNB proche de 740 dollars.

Les prises de bénéfices après le fort rallye d’août se font sentir, mais les flux institutionnels restent globalement positifs. La tendance de fond demeure constructive sur un horizon mensuel : tous ces actifs affichent des gains solides sur 30 jours, même s’ils restent en retrait par rapport à leurs niveaux de début d’année.

Tendance générale et perspectives

Sur l’ensemble des deux derniers mois, la tendance est clairement haussière après un mois de juillet plus hésitant. Bitcoin a joué son rôle de locomotive, tandis que les altcoins (ETH, SOL et BNB) ont souvent surperformé lors de la phase de reprise d’août, signe d’une rotation progressive des capitaux.

Les facteurs de soutien restent les flux ETF, l’intérêt institutionnel et les avancées techniques ou réglementaires. Les points de vigilance concernent la capacité de Bitcoin à franchir durablement la résistance des 82 000 dollars et l’évolution du contexte macroéconomique.

En résumé, ces deux mois illustrent une fois de plus la volatilité caractéristique du marché crypto : une phase de stabilisation suivie d’un rebond puissant, puis d’une consolidation saine. Les prochains semaines diront si cette dynamique haussière se prolonge ou si le marché entre dans une nouvelle période de digestion des gains.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

📰 The Ethereum community was recently spooked by a piece of news: going forward, users can pay for Gas with stablecoins, so they don’t need to buy ETH in advance.

But a crucial correction followed. EIP-8141’s Frame Transactions don’t mean the Ethereum protocol itself directly receives USDC; on-chain Gas settlement is still ETH end to end. From the user’s perspective, it looks like they’re paying with USDC, but in the background, the wallet, Paymaster, or the application prepares ETH on the user’s behalf to complete the settlement.

🔥 This proposal has already moved up from “consideration” to “planned inclusion,” slated for the 2027 Hegotá hard fork. However, it’s still only a Draft for now—at least a year away from real activation—and the detailed design may still evolve.

In fact, paying Gas on someone else’s behalf isn’t new. ERC-4337 has been live since 2023, supporting over 40 million smart accounts and more than 100 million UserOperations. What EIP-8141 aims to do is bring this capability from an external add-on into the protocol itself, reducing reliance on Bundlers, spare mempools, and the EntryPoint contract.

💡 So ETH demand might not collapse. The change is more about “who holds the ETH”: regular users wouldn’t need to stockpile small amounts of Gas, but wallet operators, Paymasters, and application providers would need to hold more ETH and complete settlements at higher frequency. Validators still receive ETH, and the base-fee burning mechanism remains unchanged.

Honestly, the real potential beneficiaries are application-layer projects. Users can complete their first transaction with only stablecoins, removing the hurdle of buying ETH first. For ETH, retail-side demand might decrease, but whether wholesale-side demand becomes more concentrated and efficient depends on whether this proposal can ultimately be implemented as planned.

🤔 Do you think this weakens ETH, or does it simply shift ETH demand from everyday users to infrastructure operators?

#以太坊 #ETH #稳定币 #Gas代付

content:
📰 以太坊社区最近被一条消息吓到了：以后用户可以用稳定币支付 Gas，不用再提前买 ETH。

但关键纠偏来了。EIP-8141 的 Frame Transactions 并不是让以太坊协议直接收 USDC，链上 Gas 结算从头到尾仍然是 ETH。用户看起来是在用 USDC 付款，背后则是钱包、Paymaster 或应用方替用户准备 ETH 完成结算。

🔥 这项提案已经从“考虑纳入”升级为“计划纳入”，排进了 2027 年 Hegotá 硬分叉。不过目前还只是 Draft，距离真正激活至少还有一年，具体设计也可能继续变化。

其实，Gas 代付并不是新东西。ERC-4337 从 2023 年就已经上线，支撑了超过 4000 万个智能账户和超过 1 亿笔 UserOperation。EIP-8141 想做的，是把这套能力从外挂式方案搬进协议本身，减少对 Bundler、备用内存池和 EntryPoint 合约的依赖。

💡 所以，ETH 需求未必会塌。变化更像是“谁来持有 ETH”：普通用户不必各自囤一点 Gas 储备，但钱包运营商、Paymaster 和应用方需要集中持有更多 ETH，并以更高频率完成结算。验证者收到的仍是 ETH，基础费销毁机制也不变。

说实话，真正可能受益的是应用层。用户只持有稳定币也能完成首笔交易，少了一道先买 ETH 的门槛。对 ETH 来说，零售端需求可能减少，但批发端需求会不会变得更集中、更高效，还要看这项提案最后能否按计划落地。

🤔 你觉得这是削弱 ETH，还是把 ETH 的需求从普通用户手里转移到了基础设施运营商手里？

Ethereum developers are advancing an EIP proposal that would allow users to pay gas fees with other tokens, with implementation targeting the 2027 upgrade.

In the last post we talked about this, and now there’s fresh progress: according to CryptoBriefing, developers have officially begun pushing a proposal for “no need to hold ETH to pay fees,” aiming for the major upgrade in 2027. Put simply, in the future, even if your wallet only has USDC or some ERC-20 token, you can still make transfers—nodes will automatically handle the gas calculation and deduct it for you. Over the past decade, using Ethereum required you to first hold ETH; this threshold is being dismantled directly.

In one sentence: Ethereum is shifting from “you must buy ETH to use it” to “it just gets deducted when you use it,” bringing the experience closer to Web2.

Market impact
- Short term: neutral. It’s more than two years away from real implementation, so there’s no direct catalyst for ETH’s price at $2,469.45. Today ETH is only down slightly by 0.47%, performing better than BTC’s -1.22%.

My take
Neutral but cautious. This is the classic kind of change: “long-term positive for the ecosystem, short-term negative for token capture.” ETH’s key still hinges on whether the $2,469.45 support holds.
